label: Making Invisible Illnesses Visible: Recognizing and Responding to Infection Associated Chronic Conditions.
summary: The emergence of post-COVID conditions (PCC) has renewed attention to infection-associated chronic conditions and illnesses (IACCI), including myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) and Lyme disease-associated chronic symptoms. Millions of Americans are affected by these debilitating, misunderstood conditions, which share symptom profiles and pathophysiologic abnormalities.
